user.title: Configure Tindeq Training Tracker
user.description: Set up your Tindeq training data integration. The storage directory should point to where your tindeq data is stored (managed by the systemd service).

data_description.storage_dir: Full path to the tindeq storage directory (e.g., /var/lib/tindeq/tindeq_data)
data_description.scan_interval: How often to update sensor data (default: 300 seconds / 5 minutes)

error.storage_dir_not_found: Storage directory does not exist. Please create it or check the path.
error.storage_dir_no_permission: No permission to access the storage directory.

abort.already_configured: This storage directory is already configured.

init.title: Tindeq Options
init.description: Configure update behavior for Tindeq sensors.
